_comment: Perturbed demand scenarios S1-S4 (Comment 1.9, kb/07_EXPERIMENT_SPECS.md E2). Base = x1.0 counts (sumo/turn_counts_edges.xml). Edit and rerun make_scenarios.py, check_demand.py and sanity_fixed.py to change a scenario.

S1.name: directional imbalance
S1._decision: 2026-10-26 (Radiuk): 1.4 -> 1.3 after the fixed-plan sanity runs (x1.4: mean departDelay 73-78 s > 60 s in 5/5 files; x1.3: 41-58 s, no flag)
S1.rounding: largest remainder over all (interval, relation) cells; scenario total = round_half_up(factor x affected total) + unaffected total; ties go to the earlier cell in file order

S3.name: peak formation
S3.rounding: per relation: peak_share x relation total spread over the peak intervals and the rest over the other intervals, each in proportion to the relation's observed counts; largest remainder per relation (relation total kept)

S4.name: turning-proportion shift
S4._decision: 2026-10-26 (Radiuk): 1.5 -> 1.4 after the fixed-plan sanity runs (x1.5: mean departDelay 68 s > 60 s in 1/5 files, T1500 1046-1079; x1.4: no flag)
S4.rounding: new left = round_half_up(left_factor x left) per interval and approach; through reduced by the same number; shortfall taken from right (logged)
